desc: Derive the remainder-transition formula for extending substrings by a digit.
Specify initialization and updates for residue-frequency tables for moduli 1 through 9, including one-digit substrings.
Confirm that only substrings ending in a nonzero final digit contribute, while zero-ending substrings remain available for extension.
Implement `countSubstrings` using compact integer arrays and a sufficiently wide answer.
Validate the implementation against all three examples and relevant edge cases.
